approaches_considered.name: forced fixed-window Ramsey intersections
approaches_considered.tradeoff: Solver-free and elementary; exactly removes 139 D5 support orbits but cannot decide signed completion.

approaches_considered.name: global rational W cross-equation relaxation
approaches_considered.tradeoff: All 844 inputs were floating-point LP feasible in 7.85 single-core seconds, so this relaxation supplies no cut. No floating result enters the theorem.

approaches_considered.name: one-hot pseudo-Boolean W/T completion
approaches_considered.tradeoff: Small coefficients, an explicit action on every relation and auxiliary variable, native cardinality constraints, and a VeriPB/CakePB certificate path. More engineering than bare CNF but closes the symmetry trust gap.

approaches_considered.name: LeanSMS dynamic isomorph-free completion
approaches_considered.tradeoff: Strong verified UNSAT path, but certified enumeration remains future work and sequential-counter auxiliaries can obscure the intended column symmetry.

architecture.deliverable: Hash-bound 705-candidate artifact, five window multiplicities, and exact four-vertex W domains with a disjoint finite checker.
Enumerate symmetric W row domains using sign degrees and Q_F R+RW=-J; reject only by deterministic tables or checked PB proofs.
Enforce W^2+2R^T R=45I-2J with exact signed overlap targets and independently replayed W witnesses.
Use the complementary support to enforce T^2=45I, modular rank checks, and exact relation recovery.
Reconstruct every surviving 45-vertex graph and independently check SRG parameters, the involution, and K5/I5 avoidance.

Pin VeriPB CP2026-enumeration at 6d38dab246af9c321b8f17cb5a187f2fbb9e491d and CakePB CP2026 at a7593ef22de2fc0b47a688f2d4f08e6b742735af; use checked deletion only and prove any preserved orbit key separately.

significant_success_gate.required: At least one additional support orbit exactly rejected by an independent finite checker or VeriPB/CakePB proof, or a complete checked W/T census over all 705 survivors.
not_sufficient: Floating-point LP infeasibility without a rational certificate.
A projected count without a theorem identifying the projection with residual column orbits.
A signed completion that is not independently checked for K5 and I5.

resource_policy: Local discovery probes use one solver process and one numerical thread.
No sustained all-core local enumeration; parallel certificate campaigns require an explicit separate launch decision.
Run the 26 published signed support types as model controls where applicable, but do not treat their K5/I5-bad graphs as positive controls for the Ramsey filter.
Record wall time, proof bytes, checker wall/memory, exact tool commits, and every timeout.
trust_model: The support and R(3,3) layers use explicit finite enumeration and independent standard-library checkers.
D5 is expanded explicitly; no solver is trusted to supply that quotient.
Residual identical-column swaps are keyed by the full pair (support mask, internal type), and every one-hot/product auxiliary must transform equivariantly.
Negative solver claims require VeriPB elaboration plus CakePB or an equivalently checked LRAT path.
Projected ENUMERATION_COMPLETE forbids unchecked deletion and requires a separate canonical-orbit-key theorem.
No fixed-five SRG result alone proves a general R(5,5) bound.
stop_conditions: Do not optimize the rational W relaxation further; it rejected zero of 844 inputs.
If a staged integral relaxation rejects nothing, retain its checked survivor models and advance immediately to the next exact equation layer.
If proof logging cannot preserve the declared residual symmetry action, fall back to fully labelled enumeration rather than accept an unproved lex leader.
Keep any conflict-limited or timeout result explicitly experimental.
